description: Valuations agreeing on every atom occurring in a propositional formula give that formula the same Boolean value.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval_congr.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α)
  (v w : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α)
  (h : ∀ a ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.atoms A, v a = w a) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval v A = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval w A
